title: Field orientation over time
alt: Four maps of the angle between magnetic field and vorticity at 64.0, 133.2, 147.0, and 187.7 milliseconds.
caption: Color gives the local angle in degrees. The range of orientations persists as the shocked region grows.

title: Where the flow rotates
alt: Bright filaments form a ring around a dark center in a map of density-weighted enstrophy.
caption: Enstrophy measures the squared strength of local fluid rotation.

title: Comparing turbulent energy
alt: Four rows of cross-sections compare turbulent energy per unit mass in the Control, T10, and T12 models.
caption: All three columns use the same logarithmic energy scale, so their spatial patterns can be compared directly.

title: Terms in the energy equation
alt: Three signed maps show the gravity, magnetic, and thermal-pressure terms.
caption: The shared red–blue scale shows where each term is positive or negative.

title: Entropy behind the shock
alt: Two irregular lobes surround a dark center in the entropy slice at 216.1 milliseconds.
caption: The slice resolves structure inside the expanding lobes.

title: Structure in the simulated flow
alt: Red and yellow lobes fan out from a central cavity, with tightly curled edges on both sides.
caption: A close view of the irregular boundary in a simulated core collapse.
